name: adaptive-agent-orchestrator
description: Model-neutral orchestration with bounded in-chat learning, capability routing, KPI verification, and cost controls.

interface.longDescription: A model-neutral management skill for complex AI work. It compiles bounded task context, keeps simple requests direct, decomposes larger work into functional roles, routes by capabilities and cost, relays structured clarification, and verifies every result against KPIs and evidence. It can learn concise, governed lessons from accepted feedback within the current chat after revision and verification. Low- and medium-cost execution is preferred; premium execution requires an explanation and explicit approval for the exact proposed model. On standard ChatGPT web surfaces, the capsule is in-chat and host-controlled: the plugin does not claim native history pruning, durable private storage, persistent scoring, independent subagents, or per-worker model control unless the host exposes and verifies those capabilities.
defaultPrompt: Use Adaptive Agent Orchestrator to plan and complete this task efficiently.
Audit how Adaptive Agent Orchestrator would route and verify this request.
Use direct mode to answer this simply without delegation.
